apps.localizedDescription: Dōchō is a fork of Mihon, the free and open source manga reader. Read straight from Kavita, Komga or BookOrbit and keep your place in sync with them, or with KOReader on your e-reader. It also has Mihon's trackers and reads and writes Mihon backups, so your library moves between Android and iOS.

versions.localizedDescription:
Version 0.32.2. iOS or iPadOS 18 or higher, on iPhone or iPad.

Download docho-0.32.2.ipa. It isn't signed, so install it with a sideloader such as AltStore, SideStore or Sideloadly. With a free Apple ID, sideloaded apps have to be refreshed every 7 days.

Added

• Extension stores (Settings → Browse → Extension stores), as on Android: every store your Dōchō Server and this device get extensions from, as cards to open the store's website, copy its address or remove it. + adds a store, to the server or this device.
• Allowed content warnings (Settings → Browse): choose whether Safe, Mixed and 18+ extensions and their sources are listed, and whether that also applies to extensions you've installed. All are allowed to start with, as on Android.

Fixed

• All of an extension's sources show. 18+ sources from Dōchō Server were hidden unless "Show NSFW" was turned on in the server's settings; the content warnings above replace that switch.
• Extension icons show for extensions on the device, in Browse → Extensions and beside their sources.
• Browse → Extensions links to Extension stores when the server has none, or can't be reached, instead of only offering to try again.
• Settings → Browse is laid out as on Android.

Version 0.32.1. iOS or iPadOS 18 or higher, on iPhone or iPad.

Download docho-0.32.1.ipa. It isn't signed, so install it with a sideloader such as AltStore, SideStore or Sideloadly. With a free Apple ID, sideloaded apps have to be refreshed every 7 days.

Changed

• Dōchō Sync is part of Dōchō Server. The separate Dōchō Sync section is gone: Settings → Sync / Self-hosted sources → Dōchō Server / Suwayomi now has Sync with Dōchō Server (on by default), Sync now and Sync automatically. It uses the server's address and its login if it has one, so there's no separate account. If you had Dōchō Sync set up, its address moves over and syncing carries on where it was.
• Dōchō Server's libraries and Series Groups aren't "Multi" any more. They're listed under Other with Dōchō Server's icon, like Kavita and Komga.
• The standalone Dōchō Sync server is retired: Dōchō Server has sync built in. Update Dōchō Server to 0.32.1 for syncing through its login.

Version 0.32.0. iOS or iPadOS 18 or higher, on iPhone or iPad.

Download docho-0.32.0.ipa. It isn't signed, so install it with a sideloader such as AltStore, SideStore or Sideloadly. With a free Apple ID, sideloaded apps have to be refreshed every 7 days.

Added

• Extensions on the iPhone and iPad, no server needed (early). Turn on Settings → Browse → Extensions on this device, add a repo under Browse → Extensions, then install, trust and update extensions as on Android. Their sources show under Browse → Sources, and their series read, download and update like any other. They run on a Java runtime built into the app (Eclipse OpenJ9), which is why the download is larger (about 88 MB). This is the first release with it: extensions that need JavaScript, image unscrambling or a web view may not work yet.
• Dōchō Server. Dōchō's own version of Suwayomi, with Dōchō Sync, libraries and series groups built in (see Optional: Dōchō Server in the README). Enter its address in Settings → Sync / Self-hosted sources under both Dōchō Server / Suwayomi and Dōchō Sync.
• Everything syncs both ways with Dōchō Server. Your library and categories, edited series details, chapter renames and Volume/Chapter types, and read progress are the same in the app and in the server's web reader.
• Edit details. A series' menu has Edit details for its title, author, artist, description, genres and status. Edited fields stay when the series refreshes from its source, and reach your other devices and Dōchō Server through Dōchō Sync.
• Progress syncs while you read. With Dōchō Sync, the page you're on reaches your other devices and Dōchō Server within about 15 seconds. Leaving the reader syncs right away, and opening a series fetches what you read elsewhere.

Changed

• Dōchō Sync uses the sync built into Dōchō Server when you enter its address; the standalone sync server still works. Edited details wait to sync until the server is updated to 0.32, and everything else keeps syncing meanwhile.
• The Suwayomi settings are now Dōchō Server / Suwayomi, with Dōchō Server's icon.

Version 0.30.3. iOS or iPadOS 18 or higher, on iPhone or iPad.

Download docho-0.30.3.ipa. It isn't signed, so install it with a sideloader such as AltStore, SideStore or Sideloadly. With a free Apple ID, sideloaded apps have to be refreshed every 7 days.

Added

• Dōchō Sync. Keep your library and categories, chapter renames and Volume/Chapter types, read progress and history the same on every iPhone, iPad and Android device signed in to your own Dōchō Sync server. Set it up in Settings → Sync / Self-hosted sources → Dōchō Sync. Dōchō syncs when it opens, when you come back to it and as it goes to the background, and whenever you tap Sync now. A device's first sync merges with the server, so reading on either side is kept.

Changed

• Downloads keep going after you leave the app. On iOS and iPadOS 26, the download progress on the Lock Screen now waits for the system to start it instead of giving up, and leaving the app mid-download asks iOS for extra time until it does.
• Smarter series titles in renames. When renaming like another chapter, or with Volume or Chapter, the series title is matched loosely, so the 8 in "Kaiju No.8" isn't taken for volume 8.

Version 0.30.2. iOS or iPadOS 18 or higher, on iPhone or iPad.

Download docho-0.30.2.ipa. It isn't signed, so install it with a sideloader such as AltStore, SideStore or Sideloadly. With a free Apple ID, sideloaded apps have to be refreshed every 7 days.

Changed

• Volume and Chapter rename entries. In the Rename dialog, picking Volume names an entry "Vol. 10" and picking Chapter names it "Ch. 74–81", keeping any title after the numbers. With one entry selected, the Name field changes so you can edit it further. With several selected, the preview shows each new name.

Fixed

• BookOrbit renames keep books in their series. Renaming a BookOrbit chapter now sends the book's current series name with its new number, so BookOrbit can't move it into another series.

Version 0.30.1. iOS or iPadOS 18 or higher, on iPhone or iPad.

Download docho-0.30.1.ipa. It isn't signed, so install it with a sideloader such as AltStore, SideStore or Sideloadly. With a free Apple ID, sideloaded apps have to be refreshed every 7 days.

Added

• Rename like another chapter. Select chapters, tap Rename, and choose Like another. Pick a chapter whose name you like (the one you renamed last is picked for you), and the selected chapters take its style while keeping their own volume number, chapter number or range, and title. For example, if you renamed "Chainsaw v10 ch 10-15" to "Vol. 10 - Chainsaw", then "Chainsaw v11 ch 16-20" becomes "Vol. 11 - Chainsaw". A preview shows every new name, and chapters whose names don't include the number it needs are left as they are.

Changed

• If a series is sorted Mixed and a rename leaves it with both volumes and chapters, it switches to Volumes first, so marking a chapter as a volume moves it in the list.

Version 0.30.0. iOS or iPadOS 18 or higher, on iPhone or iPad.

Download docho-0.30.0.ipa. It isn't signed, so install it with a sideloader such as AltStore, SideStore or Sideloadly. With a free Apple ID, sideloaded apps have to be refreshed every 7 days.

Added

• Rename chapters. Select chapters on a series and tap Rename in the bottom bar. With one chapter selected, change its name and number; leave the number empty to read it from the name. With several selected, replace text in all their names at once (for example, take "Kaiju No. 8 " off every name), with a preview of the new names and numbers. Renames stay after refreshing the series.
  - Local source: the files on the device are renamed too, and read progress is kept.
  - Komga: the book's title and number are set on the server and locked, so scans keep them.
  - Kavita: the chapter's title is set on the server and locked.
  - BookOrbit: the book's title (without the "Vol. N - " part) and series index are set on the server and locked.
  - The server account needs permission to edit metadata. If the server refuses, the chapter is still renamed in Dōchō.
• Volumes and chapters. In the Rename dialog, mark entries as a Volume or a Chapter. The series' sort settings can then list Volumes first or Chapters first (or Mixed, as before). Entries named like "Vol. 3" count as volumes to begin with.
• Hide the release prediction for a whole source. Tap the hourglass on a series and tick Hide this for every series from …. The hourglass now works on series that aren't in your library too. Settings → Appearance → Series → Hide for sources lists the hidden sources, where you can show them again.

Version 0.29.2. iOS or iPadOS 18 or higher, on iPhone or iPad.

Download docho-0.29.2.ipa. It isn't signed, so install it with a sideloader such as AltStore, SideStore or Sideloadly. With a free Apple ID, sideloaded apps have to be refreshed every 7 days.

Added

• A different position in landscape on iPad. Settings → Appearance → Navigation bar → Different position in landscape sets the bar and tab position for portrait and landscape separately, for example a bar at the bottom in portrait and a rail on the left in landscape, with its tabs at the bottom.

Version 0.29.1. iOS or iPadOS 18 or higher, on iPhone or iPad.

Download docho-0.29.1.ipa. It isn't signed, so install it with a sideloader such as AltStore, SideStore or Sideloadly. With a free Apple ID, sideloaded apps have to be refreshed every 7 days.

Changed

• Update in AltStore or SideStore. When AltStore or SideStore is on your device, the new-version dialog's button is Update in AltStore (or SideStore), which opens it to install the new version over the current one. Without either, Download still opens this page.

Version 0.29.0. iOS or iPadOS 18 or higher, on iPhone or iPad.

Download docho-0.29.0.ipa. It isn't signed, so install it with a sideloader such as AltStore, SideStore or Sideloadly. With a free Apple ID, sideloaded apps have to be refreshed every 7 days.

Added

• Release prediction. Series in your library show Android's hourglass next to In library, with when the next chapter is expected. Tap it to stop predicting for that series, hide it on that series, or both. Hide for all series… opens Settings → Appearance, which has a Show release prediction switch. A series with it hidden can show it again from its ⋮ menu.
• Reset the navigation bar. Settings → Appearance → Navigation bar → Reset to default shows every tab again, in the original order and position.

Fixed

• Opening the app after an update no longer shows a "Download completed" notification when nothing was downloading.

Version 0.28.0. iOS or iPadOS 18 or higher, on iPhone or iPad.

Download docho-0.28.0.ipa. It isn't signed, so install it with a sideloader such as AltStore, SideStore or Sideloadly. With a free Apple ID, sideloaded apps have to be refreshed every 7 days.

Added

• Update checks. Dōchō now checks this page for a new release when it opens, and again when you come back to it after 6 hours, then shows the iOS notes. Download opens this page, since the IPA has to go through your sideloader. More → About → Check for updates checks right away.
• Skip this version, or bug-fix updates. Skip this version won't remind you about it again until there's a newer release. Skip bug-fix updates (0.0.x), in the update dialog or About, only reminds you about 0.x.0 releases. Checking by hand still shows everything.
• Contact us in About opens GitHub Issues, for bug reports and suggestions.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Dōchō connects to your Kavita, Komga, BookOrbit or KOReader sync server on your local network.
